test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate idiom for the underlined word segment.**

Low count of sales, despite the sincere efforts of the sales executive, has put her team __**in a very difficult situation to escape from**.__
solution:
The correct answer is** Option (4) i.e. "In a tight corner".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In a very difficult situation to escape from:** This means being in a situation that is hard to get out of or resolve. (एक ऐसी स्थिति में होना जिससे निकलना कठिन हो) 

 
 
• **Example**: After the failure of their latest product, the company found itself in a very difficult situation to escape from.
 
 
 
• **In a tight corner: (**कठिन परिस्थिति में) - A situation where one has very few options available, typically a challenging or stressful one. 
 
 
• **Example**: The unexpected question from the audience put the speaker in a tight corner. 
 
 
 
• This idiom accurately describes a situation where the sales executive's team is struggling due to low sales. 

**Therefore, the correct answer is *"In a tight corner".***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cut to the chase: **(सीधे मुद्दे पर आना) - To get to the point; skipping the preliminary details. 
 
• **Bury the hatchet:** (मतभेद भुला देना) - To make peace or settle one's differences. 
 
• **Right off the bat:** (तुरंत) - Immediately; without delay.

140:Td4d,

The correct answer is **Option 1.**
